messages:
maria_support: FYI — WidgetCo submitted PO #3984 and uploaded a resale certificate. Invoice still charged VAT. They need a reverse-charge (EU) for DE. Attachment: https://files.redwood.internal/priv/3984/resale_cert.pdf  

maria_support: System shows `tax_exempt: false` and VIES check returned a timeout at 2025-11-03T09:12Z. Customer insists their DE VAT ID is valid (DE123456789). Can we do a manual override so billing issues don't delay their contract? :grimacing:  

tariq_billing: Thanks — can you paste the exact error from the invoice job? need repro steps to give to finance. Also, do we have the signed resale cert scanned?  

maria_support: Log snippet from invoice job:  
```
INVOICE 3984 | apply_tax() | customer.vat_check -> VIES_CALL 2025-11-03T09:12:07Z
VIES -> timeout (504) \nmark tax_exempt=false
```
They uploaded PDF but our OCR did not extract country code correctly (reads as D E with spaces). I attached the original scan.  

oleg_eng: I checked VIES traces around that time — there was a short regional outage affecting several EU lookups. VIES responded with 504 and intermittent malformed XML. See curl repro:  
```
curl -s "https://ec.europa.eu/taxonomy/vies/validate?country=DE&vat=123456789" --max-time 5
# -> HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
We should treat VIES timeouts as transient and fallback to manual review flow instead of flipping tax_exempt=false automatically. Logging a bug.  

tariq_billing: Agreed. For this thread: customer needs an invoice without VAT ASAP. Finance can apply manual exemption if we have supporting docs + PO matching billing address. Julie, can you confirm what you need to mark this as reverse-charge?  

julie_finance: We require: 1) signed resale certificate (pdf) 2) PO referencing purchase w/ business name + VAT ID 3) confirmation email from customer's finance contact. Once we have those, finance can issue a VAT credit and reissue invoice with reverse-charge note. I can approve if docs are present.  

maria_support: They provided PO and sign-off email in thread. I uploaded both to the ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-7721  

julie_finance: OK send me the ticket link and I will initiate manual override. Note: manual override is only in the finance admin tool. Tariq, can you run the admin API to mark the account pending_exempt and attach docs?  

tariq_billing: Yes. Admin API call (internal) I will run:  
```
POST /admin/customers/98765/tax_exempt
Body: {"status":"pending_manual","source":"support","docs":["/priv/3984/resale_cert.pdf","/priv/3984/po_3984.pdf"]}
```
After finance approves, we flip to `tax_exempt:true` and issue credit.  

oleg_eng: Long-term fix: update invoice worker to not auto-clear tax_exempt on external lookup timeouts. Also normalize OCR to remove spaces in country code. I can file a small PR for both.  

sre-bot: deploy/eng-runtime v2.14.3 was rolled at 2025-11-03T10:05Z — no obvious relation to VIES timeouts but flagging for correlation.  

maria_support: Customer update sent: "Thanks — we have the docs queued for manual review and expect reissued invoice within 48 hours." They replied :thumbsup:  

julie_finance: Received docs, starting manual review now. Will post update once credit issued.  

tariq_billing: Done — admin flag set to pending_manual and docs attached. INC-7721 assigned to julie_finance.  

julie_finance: Credit issued and new invoice reissued with reverse-charge note. Closing once customer confirms.  

maria_support: Customer confirmed they received VAT-free invoice. Closing thread. :tada:
